sources.finding: Native directory selection has explicit openDirectory/multiSelections modes; cancellation is not a path grant. Target folder picker remains a fixture; native authority belongs to the main-process checked path contract.
Folder chooser flags have platform-specific behavior; the old Windows promptToCreate issue is context for cross-platform negative testing, not proof current macOS behavior is broken.
Audience/resource-bound credentials matter independently of sign-in. A CLI authenticated boolean is not a grant, token passthrough permission, stable subject or cloud-product acceptance.
